rules: Blank lines contain only spaces or tabs. Same-kind siblings across blanks form one loose list. An indented line after a blank starts another item paragraph; a nonblank unindented line can lazily continue the current paragraph. Children must reach their parent's marker content column. Task checkboxes are content after a two-column bullet marker.
